For example, Ruth in Abuja counts one re: Misali, Ruth a Abuja ta kirga daya maimaituwar gyalenta: zare, ssk, saƙa, k2tog, zaren sama, saƙa. Canjin gidan yanar gizon sifili ne, don haka stitches 47 nata suna tsayawa 47 har zuwa sama.
Each yarn over adds a stitch, so pair it: Kowane yarn a kan yana ƙara dinki, don haka haɗa shi da raguwa.
Read the chart with a ruler: Karanta ginshiƙi tare da mai mulki
Keep these habits. Count stitches on eve: Rike waɗannan halaye. Kidaya dinki a kowane jere na gefen dama. Zare layin rayuwa kowane layuka 10 zuwa 20, don haka kuskure yana ɗaukar mintuna, ba kwanaki ba. Sa’ad da Ruth ta jefa zare a kan layi na 53, ta ja da baya kawai zuwa layin rayuwarta a jere na 40.
Put a marker between repeats, read the c: Sanya alama tsakanin maimaitawa, karanta ginshiƙi tare da mai mulki, kuma koyaushe toshe yadin da aka saka kafin ku yanke hukunci. Yadin da ba a toshe ya yi kama da murƙushewa.
Each pair of short rows adds 2 rows. Sto: Kowane guda biyu na gajerun layuka yana ƙara layuka 2. Tsaya kafin bust point.
Needs 5 cm more length at the front: Yana buƙatar ƙarin tsayin cm 5 a gaba
5 cm x 2.8 rows per cm = 14 rows: 5 cm x 2.8 layuka a kowane cm = layuka 14
One full row each way hides the turns: Cikakkun jere guda ɗaya ta kowace hanya tana ɓoye jujjuyawar
A takaice jeri ne ba ka gama. Kuna juya da wuri kuma ku koma, don haka yanki ɗaya ya sami tsayi. Misali, Ifeoma a Enugu na bukatar tsayin kusan 5 cm sama da bust.
Her gauge is 28 rows per 10 cm. 5 times: Ma'aunin ta shine layuka 28 a cikin 10 cm. Sau 5 2.8 shine layuka 14. Kowace gajeriyar layuka tana ƙara layuka 2, don haka tana buƙatar nau'i-nau'i 7.
She spaces the turns about 4 stitches ap: Ta baje juzu'ai kusan 4 daban, daga kowane gefen gefe, sannan ta yi aiki da cikakken jere ɗaya kowace hanya don ɓoye su. Yanzu kasan ta ya rataya matakin.
Stop the turns a little before the bust: Dakatar da jujjuyawar kadan kafin bust point, ko dart na iya haifar da karo mai nuni.
Front cross leans left, back leans right: Gicciyen gaba ya karkata zuwa hagu, baya ya karkata dama
Intarsia: twist yarns at every change: Intarsia: karkatar da yadudduka a kowane canji
Catch floats longer than about 5 stitche: Kama yana shawagi fiye da kusan dinki 5
Pair every yarn over with a decrease: Haɗa kowane zaren tare da raguwa
Extra rows / 2 = pairs of short rows: Ƙarin layuka / 2 = nau'i-nau'i na gajerun layuka
To remember. Front cross leans left, bac: Don tunawa. Giciye na gaba yana karkata hagu, giciye na baya yana karkata dama. Karkatar da yadudduka a kowane canjin intarsia. Kama dogayen iyo. Haɗa kowane zaren tare da raguwa. Kuma raba karin layuka da 2 don samun gajerun layuka na ku.
Block a small lace sample: Toshe ƙaramin samfurin yadin da aka saka
Short-row sample and a dart plan: Samfurin gajeriyar jeri da shirin dart
Now knit a mirrored cable swatch, a stri: Yanzu saƙa swatch na USB mai madubi, ɗigon ruwa da samfurin intarsia, ƙaramin samfurin yadin da aka toshe, da samfurin gajeriyar jeri tare da rubutaccen shirin dart. Hoton kowanne don fayil ɗin ku.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.
Motifs, tapestry, amigurumi and Tunisian: Motifs, tapestry, amigurumi da Tunisiya: crochet da ke siyarwa

Why this matters: Me ya sa wannan ya shafi
Joined motifs: blankets, bags, cushions: Motifs masu haɗin gwiwa: barguna, jakunkuna, kushin
Tapestry: firm bags and pouches: Tapestry: jakunkuna masu ƙarfi da jakunkuna
Crochet is fast and sturdy. This module: Crochet yana da sauri kuma yana da ƙarfi. Wannan tsarin ya ƙunshi iyalai huɗu waɗanda ke siyar da kyau. Motifs da aka haɗa suna yin barguna da jakunkuna. Tapestry crochet yana yin jakunkuna masu ƙarfi.
Amigurumi makes stuffed toys, and Tunisi: Amigurumi yana yin kayan wasan yara cushe, kuma ƙwanƙwasa na Tunisiya yana yin gyale da tulun auduga tare da saƙa. Duk umarni anan suna amfani da sharuɗɗan Amurka.
Measure and weigh one blocked square, th: Auna da auna murabba'i ɗaya katange, sannan ninka.
Test square: 10 cm across, 9 g: murabba'in gwaji: 10 cm a fadin, 9 g
Add 15% for joins and border: 828 g: Ƙara 15% don haɗawa da iyaka: 828 g
The skill is not making one square. It i: Ƙwarewar ba ta yin murabba'i ɗaya ba. Yana yin murabba'ai da yawa girmansu iri ɗaya. A cikin babban filin granny, zagaye n yana da sau 4 n gungu. Idan lissafin ku ya bambanta, murabba'in zai karkata.
For example, Bisi in Akure makes one 4-r: Misali, Bisi a Akure yana yin murabba'i guda 4, ya toshe shi, kuma yana auna cm 10 kuma yana auna 9g.
The customer wants about 80 by 100 cm. T: Abokin ciniki yana son kusan 80 ta 100 cm. Wato murabba'i 8 a fadin da 10 ƙasa: murabba'i 80, da 720 g na yarn.
She adds about 15 percent for joining an: Ta ƙara kusan kashi 15 na shiga da iyaka, 828 g. A cikin 50 g bukukuwa wato 16.6, don haka ta sayi 17, duk daga rini daya. Yanzu za ta iya faɗi farashin yarn na gaske.
Slip stitch: a decorative raised ridge: Slip stitch: kayan ado mai tasowa
Single crochet: firm, for bags: Keɓaɓɓen ɗaki ɗaya: m, don jakunkuna
Whip stitch: flat, for baby items: Ƙwallon bulala: lebur, don kayan jarirai
A slip stitch join gives a decorative ri: Haɗin ɗinki mai zamewa yana ba da ƙoƙon ado. Haɗin crochet guda ɗaya ya fi ƙarfi, yana da kyau ga jakunkuna masu ɗaukar nauyi.
Whip stitch with a tapestry needle is fl: Ƙwaƙwalwar bulala tare da allurar kaset yana da lebur, yana da kyau ga tufafi da kayan jarirai. Join-as-you-go yana haɗa kowane filin wasa a zagaye na ƙarshe, wanda ke adana lokaci akan manyan barguna.
Block every square to the same size befo: Toshe kowane murabba'i zuwa girman guda kafin haɗawa, kuma fara ɗaukar shimfidar wuri.
Change colour and fit the chart: Canja launi kuma dace da ginshiƙi
The round's stitch count must be a multi: Dole ne ƙidaya ɗin ɗinkin zagaye ya zama maɗaukakin faɗin motif.
Carry colour B inside the stitches: Dauke launi B a cikin dinkin
Pull up the last A loop: 2 on hook: Cire madauki na ƙarshe: 2 akan ƙugiya
In tapestry crochet, the colour you are: A cikin zanen kaset, launin da ba ka amfani da shi yana kwance a saman saman dinkin, kuma ka zana shi, don haka yana ɓoye.
To change colour, on the last stitch in: Don canza launi, a kan ɗinkin ƙarshe mai launi A ɗaga madauki, don haka kuna da madaukai 2 akan ƙugiya. Sa'an nan kuma zare da launi B kuma ja ta cikin biyun.
For example, Zainab in Kano has a diamon: Misali, Zainab a Kano tana da lu'u lu'u lu'u-lu'u mai fadi 12. Gilashin gindinta yana ƙara ɗimbin 6 kowane zagaye, don haka zagaye na 10 yana da 60. 60 da aka raba ta 12 shine lu'u-lu'u 5. Ya yi daidai, don haka babu motif da ke karya inda aka fara zagaye.
Stagger the increases, or the ball gets: Takaita haɓakar, ko ƙwallon ya sami sasanninta shida.
Decrease 6 per round, in mirror order: Rage 6 kowane zagaye, a cikin tsari na madubi
Stuff firmly, then close the last 6: Kaya da ƙarfi, sannan rufe 6 na ƙarshe
Amigurumi are small stuffed toys, worked: Amigurumi ƙananan kayan wasa ne masu cike da kaya, ana aiki da su a cikin ƙuƙumi guda ɗaya tare da alama a farkon kowane zagaye.
Start with 6 stitches in a magic ring, a: Fara da dinki 6 a cikin zoben sihiri, kuma ƙara dinki 6 kowane zagaye: 12, 18, 24, 30.
Work plain rounds, then decrease 6 per r: Yi aiki a fili, sannan rage 6 kowane zagaye a cikin tsari na madubi. Kaya da ƙarfi kafin zagaye na ƙarshe, kuma rufe shi kamar zaren zare.
Stagger the increases each round, or the: Juya ƙarar kowane zagaye, ko ƙwallon ya juya zuwa hexagon.
Make every toy safe: Sanya kowane abin wasan yara lafiya
Embroider eyes and noses with yarn. No p: Emroider idanu da hanci tare da zaren. Babu idanun filastik, maɓalli ko beads waɗanda za su iya fitowa.
Use new, clean toy stuffing. Sew limbs o: Yi amfani da sabo, tsabtace kayan wasan yara. Dinka gabobi a jiki sau da yawa.
Pull each part firmly before you sell or: Ja kowane bangare da ƙarfi kafin ka sayar ko kyauta. Babu dogayen igiyoyi ko madaukai.
Toy safety comes first. For babies and c: Amintaccen kayan wasan yara ya zo farko. Don jarirai da yara a ƙasa da 3, saka idanu da hanci tare da zaren. Ƙananan sassan da ke fitowa suna da haɗari.
Use new, clean polyester toy stuffing, n: Yi amfani da sabo, tsaftataccen kayan wasan yara na polyester, ba tsohowar matashin cikawa ko tsumma ba. Dinka gabobi da kunnuwa a jiki sau da yawa.
Give every toy a firm pull on each part: Ka ba kowane abin wasan wasan ƙwanƙwasa tsayin daka a kowane bangare kafin ka sayar da shi ko kyauta, kuma ka guje wa dogayen igiyoyi waɗanda za su iya naɗe a wuya.
Two passes, then time yourself: Wuce biyu, sannan lokaci da kanka
Time 10 rows and multiply. Use real time: Lokaci 10 layuka kuma ninka. Yi amfani da ainihin lokacin don farashi.
Forward pass: pick up loops, keep them: Wucewa na gaba: ɗauki madaukai, ajiye su
Larger hook and a border stop curl: Babban ƙugiya da ƙugiya tasha iyaka
Tunisian crochet uses a long hook and ke: Kwangilar Tunisiya na amfani da dogon ƙugiya kuma yana riƙe madaukai da yawa akansa, kamar allura mai sakawa. A kan wucewar gaba za ku ɗauki madaukai. Lokacin wucewar dawowa kuna kashe su, biyu a lokaci guda. Ba za ku taɓa juya aikin ba.
Tunisian fabric curls. Fight it with a l: Tunusiya masana'anta curls. Yi yaƙi da shi tare da ƙugiya mafi girma, sarkar tushe marar tushe, iyaka, da tarewa.
For example, Mercy in Benin City makes s: Misali, Mercy a Benin City ta yi gyale na layuka 225. Ta sau 10 layuka a minti 25, don haka minti 2.5 a jere. Tare da iyaka da toshewa, kowane gyale yana ɗaukar kimanin sa'o'i 10.5. Za ta farashi daga wannan adadi na gaske, ba zato ba.
Time 10 rows to know your real hours: Lokaci layuka 10 don sanin ainihin sa'o'in ku
To remember. Weigh and measure one block: Don tunawa. Auna kuma auna murabba'i da aka katange, sannan ninka. Sanya zagayen kirga mahara na motif. Ƙara dinki 6 kowane haɓaka zagaye.
Embroider features on toys for under-3s: Ƙwararren Ƙwararren Ƙwararren Ƙwararren Ƙwararren Ƙwararren Ƙwararren Ƙwararren Ƙwararren Ƙwararren Ƙwararren Ƙwararren Ƙwararren Ƙwararren Ƙwararren Ƙwararren Ƙwararren Ƙwararren Ƙwararren Ƙwararren Ƙwaƙwalwa na Ƙaƙwalwa na Ƙarƙashin Ƙaƙa na Ƙarƙasa 3 da ke da shi da kuma gwada kowane abin wasan yara. Kuma lokaci da kanka, don haka farashin ku yana amfani da sa'o'i na gaske.
Plan a motif project and join two square: Shirya aikin motif kuma haɗa murabba'i biyu
Start a tapestry pouch from your chart: Fara jakar kaset daga jadawalin ku
Now plan a motif project and join two sq: Yanzu shirya aikin motif kuma haɗa murabba'i biyu. Fara jakar kaset daga jadawalin ku. Yi kuma ja-gwajin wani yanki. Kuma yi wasan swatch na Tunisiya tare da rikodin lokaci.
From measurements to a finished garment:: Daga ma'auni zuwa rigar da aka gama: sauƙi, karkiya, makada
Daga ma'auni zuwa rigar da aka gama: sauƙi, karkiya da makada.
This is the video for module four of Adv: Wannan shi ne bidiyo don module huɗu na Advanced Knitting da Crochet.
Where every skill comes together: Inda kowace fasaha ta zo tare
Calculate a seamless raglan yoke: Yi lissafin karkiya raglan mara sumul
Garments are where gauge, resizing and s: Tufafi ne inda ma'auni, resizing da siffatawa suka taru. Kuna farawa da jiki na gaske, kuma kuna zaɓi sauƙi da gangan. Sauƙi shine bambanci tsakanin jiki da rigar da aka gama.
Then you calculate a top-down yoke, and: Sa'an nan kuma ku lissafta karkiya zuwa sama, kuma ku gama da riguna masu kyau, makada da tarewa. Kyakkyawan kammalawa na iya ninka abin da abokin ciniki ke son biya.
Bust at the fullest part, tape level: Bust a cikakken sashi, matakin tef
Upper arm, wrist and arm length: Hannu na sama, wuyan hannu da tsayin hannu
Neck and garment length wanted: Ana so tsayin wuya da sutura
A top needs ten measurements. Take the b: Sama yana buƙatar ma'auni goma. Ɗauki bust ɗin a cikakken ɓangaren, tare da matakin tef duk zagaye. Sa'an nan kuma tsayin kugu, hip da baya.
Add cross back, armhole depth, upper arm: Ƙara giciye baya, zurfin rami na hannu, hannu na sama, wuyan hannu, tsayin hannu, wuya, da tsayin rigar da take so.
Measure over light clothing, explain eac: Yi auna kan tufafi masu haske, bayyana kowannensu kafin ɗauka, kuma kiyaye katin a sirri. Rubuta kwanan wata, saboda jikin yana canzawa.
About 2.5 to 5 cm of ease. For fitted ca: Game da 2.5 zuwa 5 cm na sauƙi. Don Fitattun cardigans da saman.
About 5 to 10 cm of ease. For everyday j: Game da 5 zuwa 10 cm na sauƙi. Ga masu tsalle-tsalle na yau da kullun da cardigans.
About 10 to 15 cm for relaxed tops, 15 c: Kimanin 10 zuwa 15 cm don saman annashuwa, 15 cm ko fiye don girman rufewa.
A close-fitting top has about 2.5 to 5 c: Wani saman da ya dace yana da kusan 2.5 zuwa 5 cm na sauƙi a bust.
A standard fit has about 5 to 10 cm, for: Daidaitaccen dacewa yana da kusan 5 zuwa 10 cm, don masu tsalle-tsalle na yau da kullun.
Loose tops have about 10 to 15 cm, and o: Filaye masu kwance suna da kusan 10 zuwa 15 cm, kuma manyan guda 15 cm ko fiye. Crochet yana shimfiɗa ƙasa da saƙa, don haka yawancin masu yin suna ƙara ɗan sauƙi don ɗaki.
Chioma turns a body into stitches: Chioma tana juya jiki zuwa dinki
Finished measurement x stitches per cm =: Ƙarshen ma'auni x stitches a kowane cm = ƙidayar dinki.
For example, Chioma in Asaba is knitting: Misali, Chioma a Asaba tana saƙa madaidaicin madaidaicin tsalle ga abokin ciniki mai tsayin cm 98. Ta ƙara 8 cm cikin sauƙi, don ƙarewar ƙira na 106 cm. Gaba da baya sune 53 cm kowanne.
Her gauge is 22 stitches per 10 cm, so 5: Ma'auninta shine stitches 22 a cikin 10 cm, don haka sau 53 2.2 shine 116.6. Ta zagaye 117 don dacewa da hakarkarinta. Hannu na sama shine 32 da 4 cm na sauƙi, 36 cm, wanda shine 79 dinki.
She draws front, back and sleeve as simp: Ta zana gaba, baya da hannun riga a matsayin siffofi masu sauƙi, kuma ta rubuta kowane lamba akan su. Wannan makirci shine shirinta da dubanta.
Try the yoke on before you separate the: Gwada karkiya kafin ku raba hannayen riga.
Each increase round adds 8 stitches: Kowane zagaye na karuwa yana ƙara dinki 8
Sleeves need 24 rounds, then body only: Hannun hannu suna buƙatar zagaye 24, sannan jiki kawai
A top-down raglan starts at the neck. Fo: Raglan sama-sama yana farawa a wuyansa. Layuka huɗu suna gudana zuwa ƙananan hannaye, kuma kowane zagaye na haɓaka yana ƙara dunƙule a bangarorin biyu na kowane layi, 8 dinki a zagaye.
With a new yarn at 20 stitches per 10 cm: Tare da sabon zaren a stitches 20 a kowane 10 cm, Chioma 50 cm wuyansa shine 100 dinki: 34 baya, 34 gaba, da 16 ga kowane hannun riga.
The front must grow from 34 to 98 stitch: Gaba dole ne yayi girma daga 34 zuwa 98 dinki. Wannan shine ƙarin 64, 2 a kowane zagaye, don haka 32 yana ƙaruwa. Hannun hannu yana buƙatar 24 kawai, don haka bayan zagaye 24 ta ƙara a jiki kawai.
With a plain round between increases, th: Tare da zagaye na fili tsakanin haɓaka, karkiya yana da zurfin kusan 23 cm. Kafin ta rabu da hannun rigar, ta zame ɗigon ɗin a kan doguwar igiya ta gwada shi.
Aisha spaces six buttonholes: Aisha ta zabga guraren bututu guda shida
Stitches are wider than rows are tall, s: Dinka ya fi tsayi tsayi, don haka ba za ka iya ɗaukar dinki ɗaya a jere ba. Jagoran gama gari shine dinki 3 don kowane layuka 4.
For example, Aisha in Ilorin has a 130-r: Misali, Aisha a Ilorin tana da gefen layi 130. Rabon ta shine 22 zuwa kashi 30, kusan 0.73, don haka tana buƙatar kusan 95 dinki.
She wants 6 buttonholes of 2 stitches, w: Tana son ɗigon maɓalli guda 6 na ɗinki 2, tare da ɗinki 3 a kowane ƙarshen. Abubuwan da aka bari a kan dole ne su raba ta 5, rata tsakanin ramukan. Tare da stitches 98, 80 sun ragu, kuma 80 an raba ta 5 shine 16.
She picks up 98 and spaces the holes 16: Ta dauko 98 kuma ta raba ramukan 16 dinki. Sannan ta duba jimlar adadin ya koma 98.
Wet block. They stretch when wet and hea: Tushen rigar. Suna mikewa lokacin jika da nauyi, don haka bushewa lebur, ba a rataye ba.
Wet or steam block. No hot water with ru: Jika ko tururi toshe. Babu ruwan zafi tare da shafa, ko yana iya ji kuma yana raguwa.
Never press with a hot iron. Hold steam: Kar a taɓa dannawa da ƙarfe mai zafi. Riƙe tururi a sama, kiyaye hannaye a sarari, kashe bango.
Weave in ends with tails of at least 15: Saƙa a ƙarshen da wutsiyoyi na akalla 15 cm, sa'an nan kuma toshe. Auduga da viscose suna shimfiɗawa lokacin da aka jika, don haka bushe su a kwance, ba su taɓa ratayewa ba.
Wool can be wet or steam blocked, but ho: Wool na iya zama jika ko tururi, amma ruwan zafi tare da shafa yana sa ya ji kuma yana raguwa.
Never press acrylic with a hot iron. Ste: Kada a taɓa acrylic da ƙarfe mai zafi. Turi na iya ƙonewa, don haka riƙe ƙarfe a sama da masana'anta, kiyaye hannayenku a sarari, nisanta shi daga yara, kuma kashe shi a bango idan kun gama.
Pin each piece to your schematic and add: Sanya kowane yanki zuwa tsarin tsarin ku kuma ƙara alamar kulawa.
Finished size x gauge = stitches: Girman da aka gama x ma'auni = dinki
Each raglan round adds 8 stitches: Kowane zagaye raglan yana ƙara dinki 8
Block by fibre; steam with care: Toshe ta hanyar fiber; tururi da kulawa
To remember. Choose ease on purpose. Fin: Don tunawa. Zabi sauƙi da gangan. Ƙarshen girman lokutan ma'aunin yana ba da ɗinki. Kowane raglan karuwa zagaye yana ƙara 8 dinki. Dauki kusan 3 don kowane layuka 4. Kuma toshe ta hanyar fiber, yin amfani da tururi tare da kulawa.
Finish a sample band with buttonholes: Ƙare samfurin bandeji tare da maɓalli
Now make a measurement card and schemati: Yanzu yi katin ma'auni da tsari, ƙididdige raglan ɗin ku tare da kowane rajistan da aka nuna, kuma ku gama ƙungiyar samfuri tare da maɓalli guda uku daidai gwargwado da alamar kulawa.

Fibres and products for a hot climate: Fibers da samfurori don yanayin zafi mai zafi

Prices built from your own records: Farashi da aka gina daga bayanan ku
Good photos and safe payments: Hotuna masu kyau da amintaccen biyan kuɗi
Skill alone does not pay. In most of Nig: Skill kadai ba ya biya. A galibin Najeriya yanayi yana da zafi na tsawon shekara, don haka jakunkuna, kayan gida, kayan jarirai, saman sama da kyaututtuka yawanci ana sayar da su a hankali fiye da masu tsalle-tsalle masu nauyi.
This module shows you how to plan a smal: Wannan tsarin yana nuna muku yadda ake tsara ƙaramin layin samfur, farashi daga bayananku, kuma ku sayar da shi tare da kyawawan hotuna da halayen biyan kuɗi masu aminci.
Match fibre to product and climate: Daidaita fiber zuwa samfur da yanayi
Cotton: bags, dishcloths, baby items: Auduga: jakunkuna, kayan abinci, kayan jarirai
Linen blends: light tops, table runners: Abubuwan haɗin lilin: saman haske, masu tseren tebur
Viscose blends: lace scarves, flowing to: Viscose blends: yadin da aka saka scarves, gudana saman
Acrylic: toys, bags, cushions: Acrylic: kayan wasan yara, jakunkuna, kushin
Cotton is breathable and absorbent, good: Auduga yana da numfashi kuma yana sha, yana da kyau ga jakunkuna, kayan auduga da kayan jarirai. Haɗe-haɗe na lilin suna da sanyi da ƙwanƙwasa. Viscose yana haɗuwa da labule da kyau don yadin yadin da aka saka da filaye masu gudana.
Acrylic is affordable and colourfast, go: Acrylic yana da araha kuma mai launi, yana da kyau ga kayan wasan yara da kushiyoyin, amma ba ya numfashi kuma yana narkewa a ƙarƙashin ƙarfe mai zafi. Wool yana da dumi, mafi kyau ga kayan haɗi na harmattan.
A safe burn test for unlabelled yarn: Amintaccen gwajin ƙonawa don zaren da ba a lakafta shi ba
Short snip, karfe tweezers, bisa ruwa. Yara tafi.
Hold with metal tweezers over water: Rike da tweezers karfe akan ruwa
Paper smell, soft grey ash: plant fibre: Kamshin takarda, toka mai laushi mai laushi: fiber shuka
Hair smell, puts itself out: wool: Kamshin gashi, yana fitar da kanta: ulu
Melts to a hard bead: synthetic: Ya narke zuwa dutse mai wuya: roba
Market yarn is not always labelled. A bu: Ba koyaushe ake yiwa lakabin zaren kasuwa ba. Gwajin ƙonewa yana gaya muku dangin fiber. Snip game da 5 cm, kuma riƙe shi da tweezers na ƙarfe, ba yatsu, a kan kwano na ruwa.
Work away from fabrics and gas cylinders: Yi aiki nesa da yadudduka da silinda gas, kada ku kusa da murhu da ake amfani da su, ba da iska a ɗakin, kuma a nisanta yara.
Cotton, linen and viscose smell like bur: Auduga, lilin da viscose wari kamar takarda mai ƙonewa kuma suna barin toka mai laushi. Wool yana wari kamar kona gashi kuma yana fitar da kansa. Synthetics suna narke cikin katako mai wuya, kuma suna iya digo da ƙone fata.

Good: coaster set, about 1 hour: Da kyau: saitin teku, kamar awa 1

Instead of making one of everything, cho: Maimakon yin ɗaya daga cikin komai, zaɓi wasu samfurori a matakai uku. Misali, Tolu a Abeokuta ya shirya tarin tarin bukukuwan aure, bukukuwan suna da kyaututtuka.
Her good item is a coaster set that take: Kyakkyawar kayanta shine saitin ƙorafi wanda ke ɗaukar kusan awa 1 kuma yana kawo sabbin abokan ciniki a ciki. Mafi kyawun kayanta, babban mai siyarwa, jakar kaset ne. Mafi kyawunta shine bargon jariri na al'ada tare da farkon jariri.
She uses one colour story, cream, mustar: Ta yi amfani da labarin launi guda ɗaya, kirim, mustard da indigo, don haka hotunanta suna da kwarewa tare. Kuma ta rubuta katin samfur ga kowane, tare da zaren, ƙugiya, gram, lokaci da girma, don haka jaka na 20 ya dace da na farko.
For example, Mercy prices her scarf: 180: Misali, Mercy tana farashin gyalenta: 180g na zaren, awa 10.5, akan naira 800 a awa daya.
Handmade work is often underpriced becau: Ayyukan da aka yi da hannu sau da yawa ba su da tsada saboda mai yin ya ƙidaya zaren kawai. Farashin da ya dace ya ƙunshi kayan aiki, lokacinku, rabon kuɗin tafiyarwa, da riba.
Mercy's yarn costs about 2,500 naira per: Zaren Mercy ya kai kimanin naira 2,500 a kowace g 100 na ball, don haka naira 25 a kowace gram. Gin 180 nata ya kai 4,500, da 500 don tag da marufi.
Her time is 10.5 hours at 800 naira an h: Lokacinta shine awa 10.5 akan naira 800 awa daya: 8,400.
She adds 10 percent overhead, and 25 per: Ta kara da kashi 10 cikin dari, da kuma kashi 25 cikin dari.
That is 18,425 naira, which she rounds t: Naira 18,425 kenan, wanda ta kai 18,500 a matsayin farashinta.
Profit as a percentage of cost. Mercy's: Riba a matsayin kashi na farashi. Ribar da Mercy ta samu 3,685 shine kashi 25% na kudinta.
Profit as a percentage of price: 20%. A: Riba a matsayin kashi na farashi: 20%. Rangwamen 20% zai shafe duk ribarta.
Shop keeps 30%? Divide by 0.7. 18,500 /: Kasuwanci yana kiyaye 30%? Raba da 0.7. 18,500 / 0.7 yana nufin farashin kanti na kusan 26,500.
Markup is profit as a percentage of cost: Markup riba ne a matsayin kashi na farashi. Mercy ta kara kashi 25 cikin dari.
Margin is profit as a percentage of the: Margin riba ne a matsayin kashi na farashin siyarwa. Gefenta yana da kashi 20 cikin 100, don haka rangwamen kashi 20 zai shafe duk wata ribar da ta samu. Koyaushe bincika rangwame akan gefe.
In consignment, a shop pays you only aft: A cikin kaya, wani kanti yana biyan ku ne kawai bayan an sayar da abu, kuma yana kiyaye kwamiti. Idan ya kiyaye kashi 30, raba farashin ku da 0.7. Farashin kanti ya kamata ya zama akalla kusan naira 26,500. Yarda da sharuɗɗan a rubuce.

Your listing should answer size, fibre,: Ya kamata lissafin ku ya amsa girman, fiber, kulawa, farashi, bayarwa da lokacin jagora, don haka masu siye su daina yin tambayoyi guda biyar iri ɗaya.
